summary.title: Preparing for the Systems Design and Coding Interview
summary.one_liner: A curated guide to books, courses, sandboxes, mock interviews and Discord communities for preparing for Big Tech systems design and coding interviews.
takeaways: Systems design interviews matter most for senior and above roles; coding interviews apply at all levels.
Books such as Understanding Distributed Systems, Alex Xu's Systems Design Interview, and Designing Data-Intensive Applications build the theory needed for systems design.
Cracking the Coding Interview is the recommended starting point for coding interview prep, supplemented by practice platforms like Leetcode.
Mock interviews (via Discord communities or paid services) make a large difference, and hands-on work building large systems is a real factor in senior offers.
Create your own study plan, since big tech interviews are fairly standard and one preparation can serve many interviews.
summary.summary: Gergely Orosz shares the resources he used to prepare for an E5/E6 Facebook interview and for his Uber interview, along with those he recommends to others. The post is organized by interview type (systems design and coding) and resource type: books, courses, articles and videos, mock interview services, Discord communities, and coding sandboxes. It also covers the role of hands-on experience at work and advises building a personal study plan. The post states that none of the links are affiliate links, although a few later items mention a discount or affiliate link.
